description: Steam genre trends by tag over the last 6 and 12 complete months: change of the tag's share of releases (shareChange6m, 1.25 = +25%), releases, median reviews, share with 100+ reviews, median price and free share per window, releases by month. Filter by tag, sort by shareChange6m (default), games12m or medianReviews6m. For indie projects of 6 to 24 months; playtime is not collected (null).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to get the next page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many results per page (default 15, max 40).

order.description: desc (default: rising first) or asc (falling first).

sort.description: Field to sort by. Default shareChange6m.

tag.description: Part of a Steam tag, e.g. "roguelike", "cozy".

name: get_tag_trends

dataset.description: full radar (Pro or Studio key) or free preview (no key).

method.description: One useful sentence; full definitions in the MCP resource wieldr://methodology.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null = last page.

previewNote.description: Free preview only: what is missing, with real counts, and where to get the full radar.

title: Get Steam tag trends
